preCoordinationRequiredFor: Solo flights by student pilots without a qualified instructor on board.
Flights with a special program, including aerial work, aerobatics, parachute activity, and similar special operations.
trafficCircuitRestrictions: Traffic circuits on grass runways 16L/34R (east) and 16R/34L (west) are not allowed on Saturdays after 1300 local time, on Sundays and public holidays all day, and after 2200 local time until end of operating hours on other days.
Helicopter traffic circuits on grass runways 16L/34R and 16R/34L are subject to the same time restrictions.
publishedAerodromeInformation.note: Local aerodrome regulations from the OFM briefing pages.

arrivalPolicy: Arrival routes/sectors end overhead AUTOBAHN-OST, KALSDORF, SENDER DOBL, or AUTOBAHN-WEST; hold there for further clearance unless approach or landing clearance has already been received.
For noise abatement, maximum altitudes on entry routes/sectors should be maintained as long as practicable.
departurePolicy: Unless otherwise instructed by ATC, departing VFR flights should omit position reports overhead AUTOBAHN-OST, KALSDORF, AUTOBAHN-WEST, and SENDER DOBL.
For noise abatement, the published maximum altitudes on departure routes/sectors should be reached as soon as practicable.
transitPolicy: Transit flights will be cleared only if traffic situation permits.
commFailureProcedures: Before receiving an entry clearance: if possible divert to an uncontrolled aerodrome; otherwise squawk 7600 and enter the CTR via the NORDO route GLEISDORF -> LASSNITZHÖHE -> AUTOBAHN-OST, then continue to the NORDO holding east of the tower at 2500 ft and await light signals.

After receiving an entry clearance: squawk 7600, leave the CTR without delay via the entry route/sector and divert if possible, except for the GLEISDORF -> LASSNITZHÖHE -> AUTOBAHN-OST and SECTOR ECHO -> KALSDORF cases, then re-enter via the NORDO route to the NORDO holding east of the tower at 2500 ft and await light signals.
publishedAerodromeInformation.note: General VFR approach/departure/transit briefing and comm-failure procedure.

The west traffic circuit is not available for flights from and to 16L/34R.
